### 🟢 Approval recommended It is a small, well-tested dashboard UI change with all moved-symbol references verified consistent and no server, security, or concurrency surface affected. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR improves the dashboard's **Settings → Session Defaults** so it no longer silently hides a saved provider override that the currently-connected server doesn't offer, and it surfaces the one-time session-defaults migration notice that previously only appeared in New Session. It fits into the existing session-defaults UX work (#8265/#7728) by keeping what the user has stored visible and honest while still showing which provider new sessions will actually use. **Changes:** - `SettingsPanel.tsx`: computes a `dormantProvider` (a `user`-sourced override not in `availableProviders`), keeps it selected in the Default provider `
